review.method: Contractor assistant visually inspected all ten fixed RGB checkpoint tiles before any M3I detector or approach inference. Corrected projected boxes to visible target extents, independently of detector output.
review.scope: Selected target-checkpoints only, not exhaustive labels, independent human adjudication or physical safety certification. Dark, small, partially occluded and truncated targets retained where a distinct visible target is identifiable. Cyclist vehicle targets cover the visible rider/bicycle aggregate; person targets cover the visible person. Physical approach labels unchanged.

omissions.boreas-m3i-urban-05.2: Behind the oncoming vehicle, insufficient independently identifiable visible extent to assign a reliable 2D box.
omissions.boreas-m3i-following-14.3: Dark far-right projected person cannot be distinguished reliably from plants/occluding structures in this review tile.
omissions.boreas-m3i-following-14.5: Second vehicle is obscured by the foreground oncoming vehicle; no reliable independent visible 2D extent.

review.selection: Two source intervals fixed from pose/cadence metadata before RGB inspection, disjoint from M3C-H. Same Boreas recording, not cross-domain. Omissions are review uncertainty, not model successes; all candidates and omission reasons preserved.
